steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: At the start of battle, Swamp Thing inflicts [Nature's Curse] on all enemies for 10s. [Nature's Curse]: Reduces ATK by 30% and Crit Rate by 15%.

steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Ultimate DMG by 10%. After the start of battle, the wearer restores 4% of lost HP every 5s until the end of battle.

steps.label: 5★ Blue
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Ultimate DMG by 20%. After the start of battle, the wearer restores 7% of lost HP every 5s until the end of battle.

steps.label: 5★ Yellow
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Ultimate DMG by 35%. After the start of battle, the wearer restores 10% of lost HP every 5s until the end of battle.

guide.text: Swamp Thing's signature gear. Increases his Ultimate's DMG and provides continuous HP recovery. At the start of battle, it reduces all enemies' ATK and Crit Rate, ideal for countering early burst Champions.
